nodes.label: Research Case
nodes.purpose: The governed container for one idea: phases, contracts, sources, datasets, runs, and decisions all hang off it. Stored as append-only event tables in the SQLite control plane; nothing is ever overwritten.
limitations: Type-level node: Atlas describes the entity, it does not read live case rows

nodes.label: Hypothesis Contract
nodes.purpose: The bounded, falsifiable claim under test: the rc_<sha256> contract and its HypothesisCard projection (spec §5.1). Revisions link to parents — hypotheses have lineage, not edits.
limitations: A hypothesis is a claim, never evidence; only D1/D2 runs produce evidence

nodes.label: Registered Dataset
nodes.purpose: An rd_<sha256> reference bound fail-closed to exact snapshot-manifest bytes (per-symbol sha256 chains). The registration proves byte-identity of what an experiment may read.
limitations: Registration proves identity, not quality — audits report separately

nodes.label: Experiment (reservation → attempt → run)
nodes.purpose: One governed execution: a launch reservation (rl_…) leads to an attempt record (ra_…) linked to an immutable run_id whose v3 identity hashes configuration, snapshot, seed, and code fingerprints. D0/D1/D2 runners all publish through this chain.
limitations: Verification never trusts producer flags — attempts are re-verified against run bytes

nodes.label: Research Decision
nodes.purpose: The owner's recorded disposition (SUPPORTED/CONTRADICTED/INCONCLUSIVE/INVALID outcome; advance/revise/park/reject) in the append-only decision ledger, assembled from the fourteen-question checklist and the terminal gate packet.
limitations: Owner-only authority; deliberately absent from the MCP surface

nodes.label: Strategy Version (promoted)
nodes.purpose: Strategy development unlocked by a passed research gate: the strategy AgentBrief embeds the as-of-filtered research_promotion reference, so every strategy version traces back to the evidence that justified it.
limitations: An overridden gate is the only unlinked path, and it watermarks every run permanently
